page.layout: Top: decorative woodcut band (no text). Below it, one centred column of contents lines in the second part's list, from top to bottom. At the foot: signature "a 2" at left, catchword "VIII." at right, and a small mark at the right edge that may be a page number.

l.i: Appendix de Situ, amplitudine, magnificentia, Portu Carthaginis.

page.notes: The large initial "R" is a woodcut letter, joined to "espublica" in the first entry. The page number at the right edge is faint and uncertain. The catchword "VIII." and the signature "a 2" are printed at the foot. No running head is printed.
